# Create without counting credits.

No corporate overlords here. Your subscription powers a decentralized residential network of independent GPU operators. This GPU inference network is dedicated to accessible Creative AI, powered by the people. Welcome to the club.

Sogni Unlimited gives you fair-use access to the full open-source model library on Sogni's creator network — no render credits spent on open source images, videos, music, or LLM usage. The 3-day trial includes full unrestricted access for adults, including disabling the Sensitive Content Filter for eligible jobs.
